$comment: Which Figma collection plays which role, for scripts/figma/buildTokens.mjs and buildTokenDocs.mjs. Values are Figma collection names. Defaults are for Graphene.

semanticSpacingGroups.$comment: Semantic number groups whose LAST path segment is the class name, with an optional prefix: page spacing/page/page-padding -> p-page-padding.

/reservations/new: Step 1, Who and what: type any name, a valid email and choose a team.
Choose Recovery Strap Set in Equipment, so it is added to the list, and tick the loan rules box. Press Next.
Step 2, When: choose any period that starts within the next three days.
The warning alert shows under the date picker (another reservation already books the strap set). Nothing is saved until the last step.
